**`APIV1Service.SignIn` — `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`** (line 51)

This is the hand-written handler that implements the `SignIn` RPC. Its signature `SignIn(ctx, *v1pb.SignInRequest) (*v1pb.SignInResponse, error)` matches the service contract, and it does the real work — resolving the user via password or SSO credentials and issuing an access token.

The other `SignIn` hits in `proto/gen/...` are generated Connect/gRPC scaffolding (client stubs, handler interfaces, unimplemented defaults), not the actual backend logic.
